data.narrative:
Solar Foods is a public-stage biotech and health company that has raised $160M+. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables: Recursion Pharmaceuticals ($1.6B), Freenome ($1.1B), and Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B).

The peer-median method is the primary applicable valuation approach given data constraints. The median valuation across these three biotech peers stands at $1.1B, with the peer range spanning $1.0B to $1.6B. Public-comp anchoring using price-to-sales multiples was not applied; while the Biotech & Health sector shows a median P/S multiple of 5.5x across three public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L), Solar Foods' revenue is not on file, making this method unsuitable.

The triangulated valuation range is $935M to $1.3B, centered at a median of $1.1B. This relatively tight range reflects reliance on a single applicable method rather than diversified triangulation. Key uncertainties include the limited peer sample size and the absence of revenue data, which would enable alternative valuation cross-checks. Additionally, the wide spread within the peer group ($1.0B–$1.6B) suggests material variance in how investors value similar-stage biotech companies, introducing meaningful sensitivity around the precise midpoint. Revenue disclosure or expanded peer comparability data would strengthen conviction in this estimate.
